title: QueryAttempt
description: A retrieval that was actually made, including the ones that found nothing. This exists so 'no evidence was found for X' can be expressed as a reference to a real failed lookup instead of being fabricated as a source span. P1-TYPED and P1-BRIDGE can cite an attempt_id to mark a gap; P1-ID has no way to express that at all, and measuring the cost of that missing expressiveness is one of the study's questions.

result_occurrence_ids.description: Empty for EMPTY/FAILED/TIMEOUT. Non-empty for SUCCESS.

status.description: EMPTY (query ran, returned nothing) is evidence about the world. FAILED/TIMEOUT are evidence about the infrastructure and must not be reported as 'nothing exists' -- conflating them is a critical_harm.

gap_facets.description: EVALUATOR-ONLY when populated from TruthPacket facets. A selector may declare its own gap labels in its structured output, but those are treatment output, never gold, and must not be written back here.
